description.en: The configurations of the container image.

description.zh:
镜像类型。取值范围：

- VM：虚拟机镜像
- Container：容器镜像
description.en:
The type of the images. Valid values:

*   VM: virtual machine image.
*   Container: the container image.
The name of the custom image.
The image configuration of the virtual machine.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant add-image --image-type VM --name app-image --image-version V1.0 --description Test_image --container-image-spec '{"IsACRRegistry":true,"RegistryCriId":"cri-xyz795ygf8k90000","IsACREnterprise":true,"RegistryCredential":{"UserName":"username","Server":"registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com","Password":"userpassword"},"RegistryUrl":"registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ehpc_open/nginx:latest"}' --vm-image-spec ImageId=m-bp1akkkr1rkxtb000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpcinstant AddImage --region cn-hangzhou --ContainerImageSpec '{"IsACRRegistry":true,"RegistryCriId":"cri-xyz795ygf8k90000","IsACREnterprise":true,"RegistryCredential":{"UserName":"username","Server":"registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com","Password":"userpassword"},"RegistryUrl":"registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/ehpc_open/nginx:latest"}' --Description Test_image --ImageVersion 'V1.0' --VMImageSpec '{"ImageId":"m-bp1akkkr1rkxtb000000"}' --ImageType VM --Name 'app-image'
